title: Courant-sharp hat
words: Only finitely many vibration modes of a drum split it into as many regions as Courant's theorem allows. Find all of them for the hat-shaped drum.
math: Determine all $k$ for which the $k$-th Dirichlet eigenvalue of the hat polygon has an eigenfunction with exactly $k$ nodal domains.

title: The 89–233 basin
words: The square-plus-one map has the loop 89 ↔ 233. Show infinitely many starting numbers fall into it.
math: Prove infinitely many $n$ have $Q^k(n)\in\{89,233\}$ for some $k$, where $Q(n)=P(n^2+1)$.

title: Finitely many loops for affine prime maps
words: For fixed a and b, show the prime map p ↦ largest prime factor of ap + b has only finitely many loops.
math: Prove that for all integers $a\ge2$, $b\ge1$, the map $p\mapsto P(ap+b)$ on primes has finitely many periodic orbits.

title: Missing digits in two bases
words: Show infinitely many primes have no digit 9 in base 10 and no digit 10 in base 11 at the same time.
math: Prove infinitely many primes whose base-10 expansion avoids the digit 9 and whose base-11 expansion avoids the digit 10.

title: Square-plus-one orbit mod 3
words: Show the square-plus-one sequence starting at 2 lands on primes of both kinds mod 3 infinitely often.
math: Prove $Q^k(2)\equiv1\pmod 3$ and $Q^k(2)\equiv2\pmod 3$ each hold for infinitely many $k$.

title: Triangles through every vertex of S_N
words: Show every large number n has two partners a, b with n + a, n + b and a + b all perfect squares, all three distinct and positive.
math: Prove that for all large $n$ there are distinct positive $a,b\ne n$ with $n+a,\ n+b,\ a+b$ all perfect squares.

title: Clique minors of the prime-sum graph
words: Find the largest complete graph obtainable by contracting parts of the prime-sum graph on 1 to 2n.
math: Determine the growth order of the Hadwiger number of the prime-sum graph on $[2n]$.

title: Seven-free Friedlander–Iwaniec primes
words: Show infinitely many primes of the form x² + y⁴ have no digit 7.
math: Prove infinitely many primes $x^2+y^4$ free of the decimal digit 7.
